description: This file defines the UnwritableStreamException class within the Laminas\Diactoros\Exception namespace. It extends RuntimeException and provides specific static factory methods for different stream-writable error cases.

classes.name: UnwritableStreamException
classes.description: An exception class indicating that a stream is unwritable, with static methods for specific error conditions.

methods.name: dueToConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new instance indicating the stream is not writable due to configuration issues.

methods.name: dueToMissingResource
methods.description: Creates a new instance indicating no resource is available to write to.

methods.name: dueToPhpError
methods.description: Creates a new instance indicating an error occurred while writing to the stream.

methods.name: forCallbackStream
methods.description: Creates a new instance indicating callback streams cannot be written to.
